title: Issue triage workflow that passes the title through env
technique: An issues workflow reads the issue title the safe way (through env:, quoted) and labels the issue.

files..github/workflows/triage.yml:
name: Triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
permissions:
  issues: write
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - env:
          TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          case "$TITLE" in *bug*) gh issue edit ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --add-label bug ;; esac
